messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

As a basic principle, ACME AG receives invoices on paper or fax. These are received by the Secretariat in the central inbox and forwarded after a short visual inspection to an accounting employee. In `` ACME Financial Accounting ``, a software specially developed for the ACME AG, she identifies the charging suppliers and creates a new instance (invoice). She then checks the invoice items and notes the corresponding cost center at the ACME AG and the related cost center managers for each position on a separate form (`` docket ``). The docket and the copy of the invoice go to the internal mail together and are sent to the first cost center manager to the list. He reviews the content for accuracy after receiving the copy of the invoice. Should everything be in order, he notes his code one on the docket (`` accurate position - AP ``) and returns the copy of the invoice to the internal mail. From it, the copy of the invoice is passed on to the next cost center manager, based on the docket, or if all items are marked correct, sent back to accounting. Therefore, the copy of invoice and the docket gradually move through the hands of all cost center managers until all positions are marked as completely accurate. However, if inconsistencies exist, e.g. because the ordered product is not of the expected quantity or quality, the cost center manager rejects the AP with a note and explanatory statement on the docket, and the copy of the invoice is sent back to accounting directly. Based on the statements of the cost center managers, she will proceede with the clarification with the vendor, but, if necessary, she consults the cost center managers by telephone or e-mail again. When all inconsistencies are resolved, the copy of the invoice is sent to the cost center managers again, and the process continues. After all invoice items are AP, the accounting employee forwards the copy of the invoice to the commercial manager. He makes the commercial audit and issues the approval for payment. If the bill amount exceeds EUR 20, the Board wants to check it again (4 - eyes-principle). The copy of the invoice including the docket moves back to the accounting employee in the appropriate signature file. Should there be a complaint during the commercial audit, it will be resolved by the accounting employee with the supplier. After the commercial audit is successfully completed, the accounting employee gives payment instructions and closes the instance in `` ACME financial accounting ``.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
                  xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_ACME_Invoice_Process"
                  targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn"
                  exporter="Camunda Modeler"
                  exporterVersion="5.0.0">

  <!-- Collaboration definition with Pools and Lanes -->
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ACME">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ACME" name="ACME AG - Invoice Processing" processRef="Process_ACME_Invoice" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ACME_Invoice" isExecutable="true">
    
    <!-- Lanes definition -->
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_ACME">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Secretariat" name="Secretariat">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_InvoiceReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InspectAndForward</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Accounting" name="Accounting Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateInvoiceInstance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckItemsAndCreateDocket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendToFirstCCManager</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ClarifyWithVendor</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ForwardToCommercialManager</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ResolveCommercialComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GivePaymentInstructionAndClose</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_InvoiceProcessed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CommercialAuditOutcome</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CCManager" name="Cost Center Manager(s)">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewInvoiceContent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ContentAccurate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MarkAPAndForward</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MoreManagers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RejectAPAndDirectReturn</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CommercialManager" name="Commercial Manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CommercialAudit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Board" name="Board">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AmountThreshold</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BoardReview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BoardApprovalJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Data Objects -->
    <bpmn:dataObject id="DataObject_Invoice" name="Paper/Fax Invoice" />
    <bpmn:dataObject id="DataObject_Docket" name="Docket (Cost Centers & Managers)" />

    <!-- Process Flow Nodes -->
    
    <!-- 1. Secretariat Flow -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_InvoiceReceived" name="Invoice received (Paper/Fax)">
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_1" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InspectAndForward" name="Perform visual inspection & forward to accounting">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <!-- 2. Accounting Initialization -->
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CreateInvoiceInstance" name="Identify supplier & create invoice instance in system">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckItemsAndCreateDocket" name="Check invoice items & create docket with cost centers/managers">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendToFirstCCManager" name="Send docket & copy of invoice to first CC Manager">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_ResolvedToCC</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <!-- 3. CC Manager Loop -->
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewInvoiceContent" name="Review invoice content for accuracy">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_NextManager</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ContentAccurate" name="Content accurate?">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_AccurateYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_AccurateNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_MarkAPAndForward" name="Note code 'AP' on docket & forward via internal mail">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_AccurateYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MoreManagers" name="More cost center managers on list?">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_NextManager</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_AllManagersCompleted</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RejectAPAndDirectReturn" name="Reject AP with note/statement & send directly to accounting">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_AccurateNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_ToClarification</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <!-- Clarification Loop -->
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ClarifyWithVendor" name="Clarify inconsistencies with vendor (consult CC manager if needed)">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_ToClarification</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_ResolvedToCC</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <!-- 4. Approval Phase -->
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ForwardToCommercialManager" name="Forward invoice copy to Commercial Manager">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_AllManagersCompleted</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_ToCommAudit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CommercialAudit" name="Conduct commercial audit">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_ToCommAudit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_CommAuditDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CommercialAuditOutcome" name="Complaint during commercial audit?">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_CommAuditDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_AuditPassed</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_AuditFailed</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ResolveCommercialComplaint" name="Resolve complaint with supplier">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_AuditFailed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_ComplaintResolved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AmountThreshold" name="Amount > 20 EUR?">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_AuditPassed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_ComplaintResolved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_Exceeds20</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_NotExceeds20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_BoardReview" name="Check invoice & docket (4-eyes principle)">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_Exceeds20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_BoardApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BoardApprovalJoin" name="Approval Complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_BoardApproved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_NotExceeds20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_ToPaymentInstruction</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_GivePaymentInstructionAndClose" name="Give payment instruction & close instance in system">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_ToPaymentInstruction</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_InvoiceProcessed" name="Invoice Processed and Paid">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Sequence Flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_InvoiceReceived" targetRef="Task_InspectAndForward" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_2" sourceRef="Task_InspectAndForward" targetRef="Task_CreateInvoiceInstance" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_3" sourceRef="Task_CreateInvoiceInstance" targetRef="Task_CheckItemsAndCreateDocket" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_4" sourceRef="Task_CheckItemsAndCreateDocket" targetRef="Task_SendToFirstCCManager" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_5" sourceRef="Task_SendToFirstCCManager" targetRef="Task_ReviewInvoiceContent" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_6" sourceRef="Task_ReviewInvoiceContent" targetRef="Gateway_ContentAccurate" />
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_AccurateYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ContentAccurate" targetRef="Task_MarkAPAndForward" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_7" sourceRef="Task_MarkAPAndForward" targetRef="Gateway_MoreManagers" />
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_NextManager" name="Yes (Pass to next manager)" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreManagers" targetRef="Task_ReviewInvoiceContent" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_AllManagersCompleted" name="No (All positions AP)" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreManagers" targetRef="Task_ForwardToCommercialManager" />
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_AccurateNo" name="No (Inconsistencies)" sourceRef="Gateway_ContentAccurate" targetRef="Task_RejectAPAndDirectReturn" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_ToClarification" sourceRef="Task_RejectAPAndDirectReturn" targetRef="Task_ClarifyWithVendor" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_ResolvedToCC" sourceRef="Task_ClarifyWithVendor" targetRef="Task_SendToFirstCCManager" />
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_ToCommAudit" sourceRef="Task_ForwardToCommercialManager" targetRef="Task_CommercialAudit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_CommAuditDone" sourceRef="Task_CommercialAudit" targetRef="Gateway_CommercialAuditOutcome" />
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_AuditPassed" name="No complaint" sourceRef="Gateway_CommercialAuditOutcome" targetRef="Gateway_AmountThreshold" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_AuditFailed" name="Complaint exists" sourceRef="Gateway_CommercialAuditOutcome" targetRef="Task_ResolveCommercialComplaint" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_ComplaintResolved" sourceRef="Task_ResolveCommercialComplaint" targetRef="Gateway_AmountThreshold" />
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_Exceeds20" name="Yes (> EUR 20)" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountThreshold" targetRef="Task_BoardReview" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_NotExceeds20" name="No (<= EUR 20)" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountThreshold" targetRef="Gateway_BoardApprovalJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_BoardApproved" sourceRef="Task_BoardReview" targetRef="Gateway_BoardApprovalJoin" />
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_ToPaymentInstruction" sourceRef="Gateway_BoardApprovalJoin" targetRef="Task_GivePaymentInstructionAndClose" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_End" sourceRef="Task_GivePaymentInstructionAndClose" targetRef="EndEvent_InvoiceProcessed" />
